title: 第十二章 寡妇梁氏
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

梁二叔没有当场翻脸。

能把梁家二房撑到今天，他靠的可不光是胆子，还有一身憋得住的忍劲。

沈清萝说要封尸、封遗物、封祖坟，他脸色难看到极点，却还是当着族老的面忍了下来。

只是离开偏房前，他冷冷丢下一句：“沈姑娘，梁家请你是为平事，不是让你把家宅闹得更乱。”

沈清萝收起铜钱。

“乱的不是我。”

梁二叔脚步一顿，最终没有回头。

等人散尽，偏房只剩沈清萝、谢无咎、宋砚，还有趴在窗台上的糖糕。

沈清萝把阿福掌心那道血纹拓到黄纸上。纹路刚拓完，纸边就泛起一层黑红。

宋砚低声道：“血煞契的子纹。主契不在他身上，他只是被拿来灭口。”

沈清萝问：“灭什么口？”

谢无咎看向门外。

“他昨夜看见了不该看的东西。”

沈清萝把拓纸收好。

“祖坟、阴沟、梁二叔、灰袍邪修。现在还差一条活人证词。”

糖糕舔了舔爪子：“那个寡妇。”

沈清萝看它。

糖糕扬下巴：“本仙闻见她身上有坟土味。她去过祖坟，不止一次。”

沈清萝没有立刻去见梁氏。她先让管家带路，把阿福昨夜守夜的物件都查了一遍。

灯笼一只，火折子一枚，半包冷饼，一张被揉皱的黄纸。

黄纸上写了几个歪歪扭扭的字。

“井边有人。”

字写得很急，墨被汗洇开了，最后一笔还拖出去老长——人没来得及把这张纸递出去。

沈清萝盯着那四个字。

梁家后院有三口井，两口活水井，一口枯井。阿福名义上是守祖坟，死前却留下'井边有人'。沈清萝心里转了个弯——难怪梁二叔一口咬定死因在坟前。

沈清萝把黄纸收进布包。

谢无咎看她：“去找梁氏？”

“嗯。”

“她未必说真话。”

“活人都未必说真话。”沈清萝往外走，“但她怕的人，和这案子有关。”

梁氏住在长房偏院。

院子不破，却冷清。门口两个婆子守着，见沈清萝过来，立刻拦住。

“二爷说夫人身子弱，不见客。”

沈清萝拿出玄司文书。

“查祖坟案，问两句话。”

婆子面露迟疑。

谢无咎站在她身后，一言不发。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Uncle Liang did not fall out on the spot.

To be able to support the second wife of the Liang family until today, he relies not only on his courage, but also on his endurance.

Shen Qingluo said that she wanted to seal the corpse, relics, and ancestral tombs. His face was extremely ugly, but he still endured it in front of the clan elders.

But before leaving the side room, he said coldly: "Miss Shen, the Liang family invites you to bring peace of mind, not to make the family more chaotic."

Shen Qingluo put away the copper coins.

"I'm not the one making the mess."

Uncle Liang paused for a moment, but did not look back in the end.

After everyone had dispersed, only Shen Qingluo, Xie Wujiu, Song Yan, and Tang Cake were left in the side room, lying on the window sill.

Shen Qingluo spread the bloody pattern on Ah Fu's palm onto the yellow paper.As soon as the pattern was finished, a layer of black and red appeared on the edge of the paper.

Song Yan whispered: "The sub-print of the Blood Fiend Deed. The main deed is not with him, he was just used to silence him."

Shen Qingluo asked: "What mouth should be killed?"

Xie Wujiu looked out the door.

"He saw something he shouldn't have seen last night."

Shen Qingluo put away the rubbing paper.

"Ancestral graves, sewers, Second Uncle Liang, gray-robed evil cultivator. Now we still need a living testimony."

Tang Cake licked her paw: "That widow."

Shen Qingluo looked at it.

Tanggao raised her chin: "I smell the smell of grave earth on her body. She has been to her ancestors' graves more than once."

Shen Qingluo did not go to see Liang immediately.She first asked the housekeeper to lead the way and checked all the items that Ah Fu kept vigil with last night.

A lantern, a fire fold, half a package of cold cakes, and a piece of crumpled yellow paper.

There were a few crooked words written on the yellow paper.

"There's someone at the well."

The words were written in a hurry, the ink was smeared with sweat, and the last stroke was dragged out before the person had time to hand over the paper.

Shen Qingluo stared at those four words.

There are three wells in the backyard of the Liang family, two living wells and one dry well.Ah Fu was nominally guarding his ancestor's grave, but before his death he left behind "someone at the well".Shen Qingluo's mind turned around - no wonder Uncle Liang insisted that the cause of death was at the grave.

Shen Qingluo put the yellow paper into the cloth bag.

Xie Wujiu looked at her: "Going to find Mr. Liang?"

"Yeah."

"She may not be telling the truth."

"No living person may tell the truth." Shen Qingluo walked out, "But the person she is afraid of is related to this case."

Mr. Liang lives in the side courtyard of Changfang.

The courtyard is not dilapidated, but deserted.Two women were guarding the door. When they saw Shen Qingluo coming, they immediately stopped her.

"The second master said that my wife is weak and doesn't see guests."

Shen Qingluo took out Xuansi's documents.

"Inspect the ancestral grave case and ask a few questions."

The mother-in-law looked hesitant.

Xie Wujiu stood behind her without saying a word.
